courses_on_sale_priced_and_sold_separate.name: courses_on_sale_priced_and_sold_separately
courses_on_sale_priced_and_sold_separate.value: not "courses"."on_sale" or ("courses"."access" = 'sold-separately' and "courses"."price_centavos" is not null)

invoice_requests_sent_when_and_by_whom.name: invoice_requests_sent_when_and_by_whom
invoice_requests_sent_when_and_by_whom.value:
("invoice_requests"."sent_at" is null and "invoice_requests"."sent_by_email" is null and "invoice_requests"."sent_by_name" is null)
        or ("invoice_requests"."sent_at" is not null and "invoice_requests"."sent_by_email" is not null and "invoice_requests"."sent_by_name" is not null)

lessons_replacement_when_ready.name: lessons_replacement_when_ready
lessons_replacement_when_ready.value:
("lessons"."replacement_video_id" is null) = ("lessons"."replacement_state" is null)
        and ("lessons"."replacement_video_id" is null or "lessons"."state" in ('draft', 'published'))

orders_one_item.name: orders_one_item
orders_one_item.value: ("orders"."plan_id" is not null and "orders"."days" is not null and "orders"."course_id" is null) or ("orders"."plan_id" is null and "orders"."days" is null and "orders"."course_id" is not null)

orders_paid_already_owned_course.name: orders_paid_already_owned_course
orders_paid_already_owned_course.value: not "orders"."paid_already_owned" or ("orders"."course_id" is not null and "orders"."paid_at" is not null)

orders_paid_without_account_detached.name: orders_paid_without_account_detached
orders_paid_without_account_detached.value: not "orders"."paid_without_account" or ("orders"."user_id" is null and "orders"."paid_at" is not null)

privacy_requests_done_when_and_by_whom.name: privacy_requests_done_when_and_by_whom
privacy_requests_done_when_and_by_whom.value:
("privacy_requests"."status" = 'open' and "privacy_requests"."done_at" is null and "privacy_requests"."done_by_email" is null and "privacy_requests"."done_by_name" is null)
        or ("privacy_requests"."status" = 'done' and "privacy_requests"."done_at" is not null and "privacy_requests"."done_by_email" is not null and "privacy_requests"."done_by_name" is not null)

reviewer_pdfs_file_whole.name: reviewer_pdfs_file_whole
reviewer_pdfs_file_whole.value: ("reviewer_pdfs"."file_name" is null) = ("reviewer_pdfs"."uploaded_at" is null) and ("reviewer_pdfs"."file_size" is null) = ("reviewer_pdfs"."uploaded_at" is null)

reviewer_pdfs_file_name_length.name: reviewer_pdfs_file_name_length
reviewer_pdfs_file_name_length.value: "reviewer_pdfs"."file_name" is null or char_length("reviewer_pdfs"."file_name") between 1 and 200

staff_active_or_invited.name: staff_active_or_invited
staff_active_or_invited.value:
("staff"."status" = 'active' and "staff"."name" is not null and "staff"."added_at" is not null)
        or ("staff"."status" = 'invited' and "staff"."invited_at" is not null and "staff"."expires_at" is not null)
